items.headline: Stocks rebound Wednesday as CoreWeave results ease AI spending worries
items.note: The S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7,619.38, the Nasdaq rose 1.60% to 25,466.19 and the Dow rose 0.49% to 52,486.49. Tech was the best-performing S&P sector, up 2.7%, and the S&P 500 is about 2.6% below its October high.

items.headline: CoreWeave jumps 24.7% after beating revenue estimates
items.note: The AI cloud provider reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion versus about $3.55 billion expected, and its stock closed at $60.77. Its results calmed fears that AI spending is slowing, which matters for anyone working in AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Nvidia drops 8% after hours as the Jensen Huang investigation continues
items.note: Nvidia rose in regular trading, ending a two-day slide, then fell over 8% after hours amid reports about the CEO. The board opened an independent investigation on Nov. 8 and says Huang remains CEO; one report said the board may be considering removing him, which I could not confirm elsewhere.

items.headline: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78 a share, trading expected Nov. 19
items.note: The range implies a valuation of about $1.4 trillion, down from the $2 trillion once floated. Pricing is planned for Nov. 18 on the Nasdaq under ticker ANT, with about 20% of shares aimed at retail investors. It is a big test of public-market appetite for AI companies.

items.headline: Fed now seen hiking in December; a half-point hike gets 11% odds
items.note: CME FedWatch showed an 88% chance of a quarter-point hike on Dec. 8-9 and 11% for a half-point, up from zero a week ago. Fed Governor Waller said he would back 50 basis points if inflation ran hot. Higher rates generally pressure growth and tech stocks.

items.headline: October consumer prices rose 0.4%, hotter than expected
items.note: Economists expected 0.3%. Core prices (excluding food and energy) rose 0.3% versus 0.2% expected. September's headline reading was 0.6%, so inflation cooled but not by enough. The BLS did not publish an annual rate because of the 2025 shutdown data gap.

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield holds near 4.99% as the 2-year edges up to about 4.76%
items.note: Yields were little changed Thursday morning after Tuesday's near-5% spike. Wells Fargo's Sameer Samana urged caution on the stock bounce, citing inflation, possible Fed hikes and higher long-term rates.

learn.explain: Before a company reports results, Wall Street analysts publish forecasts, and the average of them is called the consensus. A stock often moves less on whether results were good than on whether they beat or missed that consensus. CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in revenue against roughly $3.55 billion expected, and the stock closed up 24.7%. A company can grow fast and still fall if growth is below what was already priced in.
